_doc: Per-model count of sampled parameters that are IDENTIFIABLE through the
frozen protocol and feature set, as opposed to merely sampled.
Gate N4 (tests/integration/test_parameter_activity.py) scales every exposed
parameter by 1/4 and 4x and asks whether any extracted feature moves beyond
its tolerance. Two models have parameters that do not. Those parameters are
still drawn and still vary in every ensemble, but phenotype conditioning
cannot constrain a parameter it cannot observe, so they stay at full prior
width and contribute an unconstrained dimension to the parameter geometry on
which O-information and intrinsic dimension are computed.
These are NOT plumbing bugs. test_n4_parameter_writes_reach_the_intended_
target PASSES for both models: the value reaches the intended NEURON
attribute with the intended magnitude. The N4 failure message lists three
candidate causes -- inactive, misaddressed, sign-cancelled -- and the measured
cause here is a fourth: the effect on the membrane potential is real but
smaller than the resolution of the extracted feature set.
Measured for tomko_ca1/gkdr_soma on the step_hi protocol: scaling x1/4 and x4
shifts sum(v[::17]) from -72605.84 to -72567.27 and -72663.01 respectively --
about 0.07%, a real change -- while spike_count stays 19 and ap_halfwidth_ms
stays 0.80 ms. Spike count is an integer and half-width is quantised, so
neither can register it. The dendritic partner gkdr_dend, same mechanism and
attribute over 123 segments instead of 1, moves spike_count 19 -> 1 at x1/4.
tomko_ca1's soma is a SINGLE segment of 131, and its somatic K and Ca
conductances are swamped by the dendritic tree. gna_soma is also a single
segment and is NOT dead, because spike initiation is threshold-sensitive even
in one compartment.
Reported rather than repaired: removing these parameters changes the sampled
space and would require regenerating every campaign that uses them. The
intrinsic-dimension evidence does not show the affected models as outliers
(bbp_l5pc sits at 0.889 ID per parameter, second LOWEST of eight), so the
distortion is not visible at the endpoint level. What is not defensible is
quoting n_parameters as if every one were identifiable.

bbp_l5pc.note: Both are APICAL conductances in a panel measured entirely at the soma. Corroborated independently by the Sobol total-order index: gskv3_apical ST = 0.00081 against 0.08-0.22 for active parameters (bbp base N = 64, so indicative only).

tomko_ca1.note: All three address the single-segment soma of a 131-compartment cell. See the measured gkdr_soma vs gkdr_dend contrast in _doc above.
